import tensorflow as tf
import tensorflow_probability as tfp

def multinomial_nll(true_counts, logits):
    """Compute the multinomial negative log-likelihood
    Args:
      true_counts: observed count values [B x L]
      logits: predicted logit values [B x L]
    """
    counts_per_example = tf.reduce_sum(true_counts, axis=-1)
    dist = tfp.distributions.Multinomial(total_count=counts_per_example,
                                         logits=logits)
    return (-tf.reduce_sum(dist.log_prob(true_counts)) / 
            tf.cast(tf.shape(true_counts)[0], dtype=tf.float32))

import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, auc, precision_recall_curve, roc_auc_score
x=pd.read_csv('retina.score.snps.q1.tsv',sep='\\t')
folds=np.stack([np.load(f'rod_fold{i}_lfc.npy') for i in range(5)],axis=1)
avg=folds.mean(axis=1)
pred=np.abs(avg)
ap=average_precision_score(x.label,pred)
p,r,t=precision_recall_curve(x.label,pred)
print('shape',folds.shape,'finite',np.isfinite(folds).all())
print('fold APs',[average_precision_score(x.label,np.abs(folds[:,i])) for i in range(5)])
print('average_precision',repr(ap))
print('trapezoidal_pr_auc',auc(r,p))
print('roc_auc',roc_auc_score(x.label,pred))
print('floor2',f'{math.floor(ap*100)/100:.2f}')
print('round2',f'{ap:.2f}')
print('mean_lfc stats',avg.min(),avg.max(),avg.mean(),np.median(pred))
for label in [0,1]:
 s=pred[x.label.to_numpy()==label]
 print('label',label,'mean abs',s.mean(),'median abs',np.median(s),'max',s.max())
# Confirm duplicate rows receive identical scores and dump the evidence table.
out=x.copy(); out['Rod_fold_avg_lfc']=avg; out['abs_Rod_fold_avg_lfc']=pred
out.to_csv('retina.score.snps.q1.rod.scored.tsv',sep='\\t',index=False)
print(out[out.duplicated(['chr','start','ref','alt'],keep=False)].sort_values(['chr','start']).to_string(index=False))
PY"

u='https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/sequence?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'genome':'hg38','chrom':chrom,'start':pos-L//2,'end':pos+L//2})

seqs=[s,s[:v]+alt+s[v+1:]]
bases={x:i for i,x in enumerate('ACGT')}
a=np.zeros((2,L,4),np.float32)
for i,seq in enumerate(seqs):
 for j,b in enumerate(seq):
  if b in bases:a[i,j,bases[b]]=1
expected=[-0.38262796,-0.22281218,-0.50627375,-0.6776943,-0.43265867]

 observed.append(float(p[1]-p[0]))
 tf.keras.backend.clear_session()
print('expected',expected)
print('observed',observed)
print('max_abs_error',max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(expected,observed)))
print('expected_avg',np.mean(expected),'observed_avg',np.mean(observed))
